ownerInstructionSummary: Owner approved adding music as an emotional-opening/state-access route and then instructed completion of the merger after reconciling against the new main.
approvedBehavior: Use personally meaningful, user-chosen music as an optional emotional-access cue.
Feed any useful opening into existing care, child-contact, memory, integration, and Path Performance routes rather than creating a separate therapy system.
Do not treat tears, chills, energy, vivid memory, or intensity as proof of processing or durable change.
Stop or reduce music and return to orientation/stabilization if it increases overwhelm, panic, dissociation, disorientation, or loss of stopping capacity.
Preserve intervention identity and session context so music effects are not misattributed to another exercise.
